0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, 10th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 7th in the West) after losing their last game, and Denver is 3-2 on the road while Memphis is 2-3 at home. Denver will be without Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain, while Memphis is missing Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-119 win in Denver on April 8, 2026.
